Hero.title: Geographic data becomes knowledge, technology and solutions.
Hero.description: We integrate Geosciences, geotechnologies, software and applied research — from science to spatial product.

ValueProp.title: A multidisciplinary approach
ValueProp.description: More than producing maps or processing data, we understand territorial phenomena and turn spatial information into tools that support decisions, optimize processes and create new products and services.

databases.title: Applied science
databases.description: We investigate methods, technologies and applications with concrete results in environment, territory, sustainability, spatial monitoring and resource management.

integration.title: Business perspective
integration.description: We identify problems, develop technological solutions and turn scientific knowledge into applications for companies, organizations, public institutions and innovation projects.

analytics.title: Territorial intelligence
analytics.description: We combine geoprocessing, GIS, remote sensing, cartography, geoinformation and custom geospatial application development.

Challenge.title: From research to product
Challenge.subtitle: Research can generate methods. Methods can generate technologies. And technologies can become solutions.
Challenge.description: That is the logic behind the project: bringing research, technology development and practical application closer together, creating geospatial solutions with scientific, environmental and economic value. Each project may start from a scientific question, a business need, an environmental problem or a territorial challenge.
Challenge.card_commercial_desc: Loose files, isolated maps and databases that do not talk to each other. Geographic information stays locked in one-off deliverables instead of becoming reusable infrastructure.
Challenge.card_local_desc: The spatial database organizes. GIS analyzes. Web GIS publishes. The GeoPortal connects users and projects. Applications turn all of that into tools for teams.

Engine.badge: GIS, GeoPortal and Spatial Intelligence Solutions
Engine.title: Spatial technology applied to business
Engine.description: We develop geospatial solutions for companies, consultancies and organizations that need to turn spatial data into information, analysis and decision-making. Platforms and applications to organize, integrate, analyze and publish geographic information in digital environments.

Pillars.title: Our focus
Pillars.subtitle: Understand space. Turn data into information. Turn information into technology. And turn technology into a solution.
Pillars.routing_desc: Corporate and institutional GeoPortals, interactive geographic applications, dashboards and maps for querying, visualizing and sharing territorial information.
Pillars.bi_desc: Spatial databases, geoprocessing, integration of geographic sources and systems for management, territorial and environmental monitoring.
Pillars.topology_desc: Platforms for field data collection and visualization, satellite imagery, photogrammetry and custom applications for consultancies and tailored projects.

CustomEngineering.title: Custom solutions for consultancies and projects
CustomEngineering.subtitle: Every company has different processes, data and needs. We build modularly — from a project-specific app to a complete geospatial platform.
CustomEngineering.observation_desc: We integrate land use, shoreline, protected areas, ecosystems, infrastructure, field surveys and satellite imagery into GeoPortals and Web GIS for teams, managers and clients.
CustomEngineering.logistics_desc: Collect → store → process → analyze → visualize → share → deliver. Reduce data fragmentation and create a reusable technology structure across contracts and studies.
CustomEngineering.infrastructure_desc: Spatial Database + GIS + Web GIS + GeoPortal + APIs + Applications + Field Data + Remote Sensing — an integrated solution for the company's real problem.

Portfolio.title: Delivery portfolio
Portfolio.subtitle: Real project screenshots across GeoPortal, Web GIS, spatial databases, photogrammetry and territorial intelligence.

webgis_municipal.title: Municipal WebGIS
webgis_municipal.description: Geoportal with orthomosaics, cadastre and multilayer maps — vector editing, heatmaps and executive reporting.

webgis_devgis.title: Corporate Geoportal
webgis_devgis.description: Custom geospatial hub: corporate layers, live editing, thematic filters, heatmaps and publishing for partner agencies.

webgis_audit.title: Aerial Survey Audit
webgis_audit.description: WebGIS to compare campaigns, overlay orthomosaics/DTMs, quality indicators and technical review trails.

webgis_epi.title: Epidemiological Surveillance
webgis_epi.description: Municipal platform with heatmaps, traps, threshold alerts and operational support against arboviruses.

spatial_db.title: Spatial Database Management
spatial_db.description: Activity and city-block management, consistency audits, cross-database sync and spatial data-quality panels.

aero.title: High-Precision Photogrammetry
aero.description: Drone + GNSS (RTK/PPK) and Metashape: orthomosaics, DTM/DSM, classified clouds, volumes and CAD/BIM integration.

Contact.title: Shall we turn spatial data into a solution?
Contact.description: Spatial data does not have to stay locked in files and maps. It can become systems, platforms and digital solutions. Message me for a free 30-minute technical diagnosis.
